payload.title: PSS IMP-MOD-01: make Models runtime scopes an opaque, lifecycle-safe service
currentProgress: CTR-MOD was accepted in PR #1271 and CTR-SES in PR #1269; both are merged on main.
The published Models root slice owns runtime-scope contracts, while Factory Sessions owns identity/opening boundaries.

This packet has the exclusive target lease pkg/services/models/internal/services/runtime_scopes and must not broaden into catalog, assets, host, inference, Wire, CLI, HTTP, OpenAPI, or generated-contract work.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-MOD-01 as one narrow observable vertical slice: opaque Models runtime scopes can be opened and closed through the accepted root contracts and bindings; stale or foreign scopes are rejected deterministically; construction remains inert with no deferred service construction. Add focused behavior and boundary evidence, preserve existing public behavior, and run relevant package/boundary tests.

payload.title: PSS IMP-REC-02: make Recordings projection queries deterministic across live and replay
currentProgress: CTR-REC was accepted in PR #1280 and is merged on main.
The Recordings root contract publishes the projection-query slice and retains canonical event ownership.

This packet has the exclusive target lease pkg/services/recordings/internal/services/projection_query and must not modify shared event vocabulary, runtime orchestration, visualization live projection, Wire, HTTP, CLI, OpenAPI, or generated artifacts.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-REC-02 as one narrow observable vertical slice: deterministic projection queries reduce canonical recordings so live state equals replayed state, and reconnect cursors are handled predictably. Keep projection/query implementation private behind the accepted Recordings root contract, add focused live-versus-replay and reconnect-cursor evidence, and run relevant package/boundary tests.

payload.title: Reconcile Models and Recordings owner-local implementation wave
payload.requestedOutcome: After both IMP-MOD-01 and IMP-REC-02 reach complete, inspect their reviews, changed paths, tests, queue health, and portfolio contention before deciding whether to release their successors or revise the PSS plan.
